library(GAPR)
library(readr)

bbc <- read_delim("C:/Users/USER/Downloads/reddata_no_y.txt", delim = "\t", col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE)

bbc <- as.data.frame(lapply(bbc, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))))

n_original <- rownames(bbc)
x_original <- colnames(bbc)

respond = GAP(
    data = bbc,
    row.prox = 'pearson',
    col.prox = 'pearson',
    row.order = 'average',
    col.order = 'average',
    border = TRUE,
    PNGfilename = 'redwine的GAP.png',
    show.plot = TRUE,
    exp.row_order = TRUE,
    exp.row_prox = TRUE
)

rowprox <- as.matrix(respond$row_prox)
doc_order <- respond$row_order
doc_numbers <- doc_numbers_original[doc_order]
doc_order
# 分群：可視需要切成 K 群（例：2 群）
doc_cluster <- cutree(hclust(as.dist(1 - rowprox)), k = 6)

doc_numbers[doc_cluster == 1]
doc_numbers[doc_cluster == 2]

gap_cluster_df <- data.frame(filename = doc_numbers, gap_cluster = doc_cluster)
write.csv(gap_cluster_df, "gap_redwine_clusters.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✅ GAP 分群結果已儲存為 gap_redwine_clusters.csv\n")

rowprox <- as.matrix(respond$row_prox)

# 若沒有列名，先造一份
if (is.null(rownames(rowprox))) {
  labels <- paste0("doc_", seq_len(nrow(rowprox)))
  rownames(rowprox) <- labels
  colnames(rowprox) <- labels
}

hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - rowprox))
doc_cluster <- cutree(hc, k = 6)

doc_numbers <- setNames(rownames(rowprox), rownames(rowprox))  # 顯示用
group1 <- doc_numbers[names(doc_cluster)[doc_cluster == 1]]
group2 <- doc_numbers[names(doc_cluster)[doc_cluster == 2]]
group3 <- doc_numbers[names(doc_cluster)[doc_cluster == 3]]
group4 <- doc_numbers[names(doc_cluster)[doc_cluster == 4]]
group5 <- doc_numbers[names(doc_cluster)[doc_cluster == 5]]
group6 <- doc_numbers[names(doc_cluster)[doc_cluster == 6]]

length(group1)
length(group2)
length(group3)
length(group4)
length(group5)
length(group6)

# 假設這時候 rowprox、doc_cluster 都已建立
stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(rowprox)))
stopifnot(identical(names(doc_cluster), rownames(rowprox)))

# 若你希望 filename 就是 rownames(rowprox)
doc_numbers <- setNames(rownames(rowprox), rownames(rowprox))

gap_cluster_df <- data.frame(
  filename    = names(doc_cluster),      # 與 rownames(rowprox) 等長且同序
  gap_cluster = as.integer(doc_cluster), # 轉成整數以利外部處理
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 依群組、再依檔名排序（可選）
gap_cluster_df <- gap_cluster_df[order(gap_cluster_df$gap_cluster, gap_cluster_df$filename), ]

write.csv(gap_cluster_df, "gap_redwine_clusters.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("GAP 分群結果已儲存為 gap_redwine_clusters.csv\n")
